summary: Fix the checkout button focus order that left the keyboard shopper tabbing past the Place Order control, while preserving the existing visual button order for mouse users.

edits.replace:
<S.SubmitContainer>
        <Link href="/" passHref legacyBehavior>
          <S.CartButton as="a" $type="secondary">Continue Shopping</S.CartButton>
        </Link>
        <S.CartButton data-cy={CypressFields.CheckoutPlaceOrder} type="submit">Place Order</S.CartButton>
      </S.SubmitContainer>
edits.why: This makes the desktop tab order match the visible button order and removes the nested link/button tab trap before checkout submission.
This preserves the current visual button placement while allowing keyboard focus to reach Place Order in the expected sequence.
